author: Xeferus
quote: The sheer audacity of Take Two and Rockstar and their affiliated shills, to do what they have done to gaming and think people wouldn't notice or wouldn't care. This game has ushered in several major negative precedents and they thought we would just quietly accept it. We want physical games and game ownership, we want a game without micro transactions and subscription services, we want quality control and polished games on release with minimal bugs and good performance, we want good stories with compelling gameplay. You have failed at all of these with this game and you enlisted your industry sycophants to tell us it's the best thing ever. Real gamers, people with eyes ears and a brain, we reject your attempts and remind you that we are why you exist. I hope you realize this and survive the consequences to get back to basics. Oh and we want game journalists with a backbone that aren't paid to shill blatant lies and hype about a buggy game with many flaws claiming it's the greatest game ever made when it's far from it.

author: Xeferus
quote: A masterpiece reborn! A superb remake from the ground up. The bones and the soul and the story are all there. Just fleshed out like you never could have imagined. So many epic additions to visuals, cutscenes, easter eggs, lore, you name it. Absolute cinema! The greatest got greater!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
